from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u057/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for r in range(h):
        pts = [c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != background]
        for a, b in zip(pts, pts[1:]):
            for c in range(a + 1, b):
                out[r][c] = 3
    for c in range(w):
        pts = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] != background]
        for a, b in zip(pts, pts[1:]):
            for r in range(a + 1, b):
                out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
p=base/'task-3a7aaaad.py'; p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'),globals())
